nameOfQualification: Supervisor- Maintenance (Pharma, Biologics and Medical Device Facility) Electives: 1.Electricity, 2.HVAC , 3.Water System, 4.Gases, 5.Steam
description: Supervisor-Maintenance (Pharma, Biologics and Medical Device Facility) is responsible for supervising Maintenance Technician and Assistant and oversee the maintenance activities of the plant/ facility in a regulated/ semi-regulated plant/ research center. The job role holder is responsible for identifying and resolving critical issues related to installation, operation, maintenance or break down of specialized utility like electrical, HVAC, water, gases or steam. The individual is responsible for overseeing current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) critical engineering functions and ensuring the adherence to regulatory/ GMP and Environment, Health, and Safety(EHS) guidelines.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling
